text: Agile methodology is a modern way of managing projects, especially in software development. Instead of planning everything at the beginning, teams work in short cycles called sprints, usually lasting two to four weeks. Before each sprint, the team chooses tasks from a backlog, which is a prioritized list of user stories describing what users need. Every day, team members hold quick standups to share progress and discuss problems. This iterative development approach allows teams to test their work regularly, receive feedback, and make improvements. As a result, Agile helps teams respond quickly to changes and deliver useful products to customers faster.
